subject.title: Discover live model inventory + data-driven picker matching (robust to new models)

question: Should browser mode intentionally accept raw model names found in ChatGPT’s live picker even when they are absent from Oracle’s maintained model catalog?
rationale: The patch changes the supported model-selection contract, not merely its DOM implementation: values such as `o3` would begin working through browser discovery despite not being recognized by normal CLI model inference.

options.title: Allow browser-only live models
options.body: Keep the curated API catalog, but let explicit browser `-m` values resolve against live picker inventory with the existing selector retained as fallback.

options.title: Retain catalog-only selection
options.body: Use inventory discovery only to locate known Oracle model aliases and reject models that are not represented in the maintained catalog.

recommendation.title: Allow browser-only live models
recommendation.body: Keep the curated API catalog, but let explicit browser `-m` values resolve against live picker inventory with the existing selector retained as fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history and recent merge activity make him the strongest available owner for Oracle’s browser model-selection contract.
